metadata.description: N=1 single-pass evaluation at 384px, 14-buffer standard (5-150m) + MCC, 487 tiles
metadata.purpose: Standard-compliant re-score of all 18 single-pass N=1 baselines at the 14 uniform buffers plus tile-level MCC. Supersedes the 4-buffer (20/30/40/50m, no-MCC) sweep in n1-eval-384px-all-buffers.yaml so the baseline matrix can be authored as valid condition rows.
